disclaimer.title: Before you start
disclaimer.intro: Spike is a personal helper tool that displays glucose readings from your CGM (Dexcom, Libre, or Nightscout). It is provided as-is, with no warranties.
disclaimer.keepOpenBody: Alarms only work while Spike is open on screen. If you lock your phone, switch to another app, or close Spike, it stops checking your glucose and will NOT alarm. Leave it open with the screen on, ideally plugged in.
disclaimer.notMedicalBody: This app is NOT a medical device and should NOT be used as your sole source for glucose monitoring. Always rely on your official CGM receiver or app for medical decisions.
disclaimer.noDataBody: Your credentials are stored securely on your device only. Glucose data is fetched directly from your CGM provider’s servers to your phone. We do not collect, store, or transmit any of your data.
disclaimer.supplementaryBody: The alarms in this app are meant to supplement, not replace, your CGM alerts. Do not disable your CGM alarms.

dexcom.hint: Use the sharer's credentials (the account connected to the sensor), not a follower account.

libre.hint: Use your LibreLinkUp credentials (the follower app, not LibreLink).

nightscout.hint: Enter your Nightscout site URL. Add a readable token if your site requires authentication.

errors.invalidCredentials: Invalid credentials or account not found

settings.repeatFooter: Urgent Low and Urgent High repeat every {{count}} minutes until glucose is back in range.
settings.snoozeWarning: Snoozing longer than {{count}} minutes may delay critical alerts. Use with caution.
